verdict.reasoning: Patient reports: "I've just had some diarrhea for the last three days" and "probably like six or seven times a day" and describes it as "loose and watery stool".

Patient reports pain "in my lower abdomen... just to one side" and specifies "on the left side," describing it as "like a cramp, like a muscular cramp," that "comes and goes," and also says "i feel a bit uh weak and shaky."
Doctor asks about blood in stools and patient replies: "No, no blood, yeah, just watery and loose stool."
Patient states: "I vomited at the start of the symptoms but now um I've stopped vomiting" and confirms vomit was normal in color with "No no blood, no."

Patient says: "I haven't had a fever, um, at the moment, but I did notice um a temperature when the symptoms started, so, um, yeah around about three or four days ago." This supports subjective fever at onset and no current fever.

Patient says: "I had a loss of appetite... I haven't been eating as much, but I've been able to hold down fluids" and describes eating "just soups, and... light foods. Like smoothies and, yeah, liquid foods mainly."

Patient reports: "I had takeaway about four days ago" at "a Chinese restaurant with friends" and notes in household "one child was vomiting, but they haven't got diarrhea. There's no one with the same symptoms."

Patient says diarrhea has meant "I need to stay close to the toilet 'cause I go quite frequently" and confirms work: "I work, er. Um, I'm an accountant" and "I've been going to work... it's been quite difficult."
Patient states: "other than um athsma, um I use an inhaler, everything else is fine" and confirms control: "yeah, that's fine... that's under control."
In PMH, patient notes: "I use an inhaler" and later confirms: "I just, yeah, use an inhaler."

Doctor summarizes living situation: "you said, you mentioned you live with your wife and two children" and patient confirms "Yes"; for smoking and alcohol patient says: "no, I don't smoke" and "no, I I don't drink alcohol, no."

Doctor’s recap: "for the last three days you've been having loose stool, diarrhea, a bit of tummy pain uh mainly on the left-hand side, um and vomiting and fever" and diagnoses: "you may have something, uh, called gastroenteritis... mainly caused by viruses but there can be a possibility of bacteria" and links to trigger: "you mentioned you had this Chinese takeaway as little as three days ago and I wondered whether that might be the cause." No blood in stool previously confirmed; patient tolerating fluids also documented. The summary matches this assessment, including likely viral with possible bacterial and temporal association with takeaway (3–4 days).

Doctor advises: "there are things like Dioralyte you can get from the pharmacy, which... helps replenish your minerals and vitamins" and in context of conservative management and hydration: "making sure you're well hydrated, so drinking fluids."
Doctor says: "If you are feeling feverish and weak, eh taking some paracetamol, uh, two tablets up to four times a day for the first few days can also help."
Doctor explicitly states: "I don't think you need anything like antibiotics. It's really just... making sure you're well hydrated."
Doctor: "I will certainly advise you to take some time off work... I would say the next two, two to three days as the infection clears from your system to take some time off and rest."

Doctor states: "if your symptoms haven't got better, you know, in in three to four days, I'd like to come and see you again" and adds "we may need to do further tests like um taking a sample of your stool so we can test that."
